digest.component_or_area: graph subsystem (blockers, cycle detection, unblock operations)
propositions: Four functions (_find_direct_blockers CCN 18, _get_all_blocked_by CCN 20, check_cycle_at_level CCN 16, detect_newly_unblocked CCN 22) have moderate cyclomatic complexity elevated by duplicated reduce_all+drop error/fsck+index logic and hand-rolled BFS patterns

The identical 'reduce_all_tickets(exclude_archived=False, exclude_session_logs=True) → drop error/fsck_needed → index by id' loop appears verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving unnecessary duplication
BFS skeleton for traversing ticket dependencies is independently reimplemented in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level, each with queue/visited bookkeeping and per-node reduce_ticket calls
Extracting shared load_indexed_states helper and accumulator-returning bfs(starts, neighbors_fn) will reduce all four functions below CCN 15 threshold while preserving node-sets and traversal results

Existing test suite (tests/scripts/graph/ and tests/scripts/test_ticket_unblock.py) must pass unchanged; new characterization test must verify _get_all_blocked_by includes targets with no backing dir and excludes seed id
